segments.speaker: Person 5 (Sam Okafor)
segments.text: Thanks for joining, Tom. We wanted to cover the webhook problems and then the renewal.

segments.speaker: Person 10 (Tom Becker)
segments.text: Appreciated. The webhook retries have been failing for two weeks. Our operations team noticed missing shipment updates.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: We found the cause. Our retries were hitting your endpoint too quickly. Lee is adding backoff this week, so it should be resolved by Friday.

segments.speaker: Person 10 (Tom Becker)
segments.text: Good. On the renewal, our contract value is up for review in November and finance wants a better number.

segments.speaker: Person 5 (Sam Okafor)
segments.text: We can do a 15% discount if you sign a two-year renewal. That keeps the same feature set and adds priority support.

segments.speaker: Person 10 (Tom Becker)
segments.text: I'll take that to finance. A two-year term is probably fine if the webhook issue is really fixed.
